title: Sort Age of Players in Ascending Order

blocks.content: Sort Age of Players in Ascending Order
Write a program to sort the age of players in ascending order.

items: Get three integer inputs from the user and store them in the input1, input2, and input3 variables.
Create an integer vector called age.
Add input1, input2, and input3 to the vector.
Use the sort() algorithm to sort the vector in ascending order.

blocks.content: Hint: Use the begin() and end() iterators in sort() algorithm.
